It is recommended that the City Council authorize the City Manager to sign a Letter of Authorization (LOA) to allow the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments to apply for CalRecycle Round Two SB 1383 Local Assistance Grant Program funds on behalf of the City.

3.. A Resolution Amending the Capital Improvement Program Project Budget for the “Water Resources Building” Project and Approve Payment to H2 Environmental Consulting Services, Inc., for Services Rendered

It is recommended that the City Council take the following actions:

1)	Adopt the following resolution:

RESOLUTION NO. 2023-199 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF POMONA, CALIFORNIA AMENDING THE FY 2023-24 CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM (CIP) BUDGET BY APPROPRIATING $700,000 OF WATER FUND RESERVES TO “WATER RESOURCES BUILDING” PROJECT NO. 575-8125-XXXXX-93135

2)	Approve payment in the amount of $65,550 to H2 Environmental Consulting Services, Inc. (H2) for professional services for services rendered.

4.. Approve First Agreement Amendment for Consultant Services Civiltec Engineering, Inc. for “Reservoir Assessment and Rehabilitation Design” Project

It is recommended that the City Council take the following actions:

1)	Amend the professional services agreement with Civiltec Engineering, Inc. increasing the agreement by $63,200 (from $109,530 to $172,730) for the “Reservoir Assessment and Rehabilitation Design,” Project No. 428-2590-XXXXX-95081; and,

2)	Authorize the City Manager, or designee, to execute the agreement amendment with Civiltec Engineering, Inc. on behalf of the City and any subsequent documents or amendments, subject to approval by the City Attorney.

5.. Award Bids to: Zenner Performance Meters, Inc.; Accurate Measurement Systems; and, United Water Works for Warehouse Materials

It is recommended that the City Council take the following actions:

1)	Award a bid to Zenner Performance Meters, Inc., (Zenner) for the purchase of large cold water meters at the per-unit prices bid for a term of three (3) years with an extension option for up to two (2) additional years;

2)	Approve a sole source award to Accurate Measurement Systems, Inc., (AMS) for the purchase of Krohne Electromagnetic Flow Meters, for a five (5) year term, at the market prices;

3)	Award a bid to United Water Works (United), for the one time purchase of fire hydrants and hydrant guard surge protectors, at the per-unit price bid, in the amount of $327,446; and,

4)	Authorize the City Manager, or designees, to approve purchase agreements, and any extensions thereto, on behalf of the City.

6.. Adopt a Resolution Amending Fiscal Year 2023-24 Sewer Operating Budget by Appropriating $424,000 of Available Sewer Fund Reserves; and, Award Bid to Faze 1 Corporation dba Premier Pipe Inc., for Sanitary Sewer Cleaning and Closed Circuit Television Inspection Services

It is recommended that the City Council take the following actions:

1)	Adopt the following resolution: 

RESOLUTION NO. 2023-194 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF POMONA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2023-24 SEWER OPERATING BUDGET BY APPROPRIATING $424,000 FROM THE AVAILABLE SEWER FUND RESERVES

2)	Award a bid in the amount to Faze 1 Corporation dba Premier Pipe (Faze 1) for a three-year agreement with two additional one-year renewal options, for sewer cleaning and Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) inspection services, at the prices bid, in the amount not-to-exceed of $480,000; and,

3)	Authorize the City Manager, or designee, to execute a three-year agreement with two one-year renewal options with Faze 1 on behalf of the City and any subsequent documents or amendments, subject to approval by the City Attorney.

7.. Resolution to Amend the FY 2023-24 Capital Improvement Program (CIP) Budget by Creating a New Project, Closing Completed Projects, and Re-appropriating Unexpended Funds

It is recommended that the City Council adopt the following resolution:

RESOLUTION NO. 2023-190 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF POMONA, CALIFORNIA, TO AMEND THE FY 2023-24 CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM (CIP) BUDGET BY CREATING A NEW PROJECT, “DISTRICT 2 - NEW PLAYGROUND AT RALPH WELCH PARK,” PROJECT NO. 428-2590-XXXXX-71096, CLOSING COMPLETED PROJECTS, RELEASING $134,022 OF UNEXPENDED FUNDS, REAPPROPRIATING $63,478 OF UNEXPENDED GENERAL FUNDS TO THE NEW PROJECT, UNAPPROPRIATING $90,183 OF AMERICAN RESCUE PLAN FUNDING (D2) FROM “BUENA VISTA AVENUE REHABILITATION - MISSION BOULEVARD TO 9TH STREET,” PROJECT NO. 428-2590-XXXXX-68576, AND REAPPROPRIATING THIS FUNDING TO THE NEW PROJECT

8.. Approve a Memorandum of Agreement between the City of Pomona and the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments for the Allocation of Funds for “Transit Improvement Program, Gold Line,” Project No. 428-2590-XXXXX-68559

It is recommended that the City Council take the following actions:

1)	Approve a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) between the City of Pomona and the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments (SGVCOG) to allocate $595,000 of funds received from Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority (“LACMTA/METRO”) through the Measure M Multi-Year Subregional Program (“MSP”), as well as, up to $1,600,000 of the City’s General Purpose (Prop A Exchange) Funds for “Transit Improvement Program, Gold Line,” Project No. 428-2590-XXXXX-68559; and

2)	Authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to execute the proposed MOA between the City of Pomona and the SGVCOG and related documents, subject to approval as to form by the City Attorney.

It is recommended that the City Council take the following actions:

1)	Adopt the following resolution: 

RESOLUTION NO. 2023-189 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF POMONA, CALIFORNIA, AUTHORIZING THE ACCEPTANCE OF $86,994 IN MEASURE H HOMELESS INITIATIVE FUNDS TO LOCALLY ADMINISTER THE HOMELESS INCENTIVE PROGRAM (HIP) AND THE AMENDMENT OF THE FY 2023-24 OPERATING BUDGET BY INCREASING REVENUE ESTIMATES AND APPROPRIATIONS BY $60,610

1)	Adopt the following resolution:

RESOLUTION NO. 2023-197 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF POMONA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING LOT MERGER LM10-2023 FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 1400 W. MCKINLEY AVENUE, POMONA, CA, ASSESSOR PARCEL NUMBER 8360-030-029

It is recommended that the City Council adopt the following resolution:

RESOLUTION NO. 2023-198 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF POMONA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE FY 2023-24 WATER ENTERPRISE FUND BUDGET TO INCREASE REVENUE ESTIMATES AND APPROPRIATIONS BY $20,000 FOR THE MEMBER AGENCY ADMINISTERED INCENTIVE PROGRAMS FOR THE RESIDENTIAL IRRIGATION CONTROLLER INSTALLATION PROGRAM AND RESIDENTIAL LANDSCAPE AUDIT; AND $3,000 FOR THE COMMUNITY PARTNERING PROGRAM

16.. Appointing Staff Representation on the Pomona Valley Protective Association Board and the Pomona-Walnut-Rowland Joint Pipeline Commission JPA
